_comment: PLC Guardian config. Edited live during the demo: the proxy re-reads this file when it changes. Values marked [UNVERIFIED] are placeholders until the PLC register map exists.

192.168.8.2.name: HMI (team laptop running updated HMI project, seen in Test1 2026-10-21)

unknown_sources._comment: Anything not in authorized_sources. allow_reads=false blocks even reads from unknown hosts.

protected_points.name: %M4 Maintenance bypass (ON defeats the level-80 stop)
%MW0 Tank level (= counter %C0.V, computed by the PLC)

enforcement._comment: mode: 'monitor' = forward everything, detect + log only (demo Iteration 1). 'block' = drop unauthorized requests (Iteration 2). block_response: 'exception' (send Modbus exception) or 'reset' (close the TCP connection).

proxy._comment: Inline mode. Clients connect to listen_host:listen_port; allowed requests are forwarded to upstream (the real PLC). See README 'Inline topology'.

_comment_map: Register map from the 'Wireshark tank values PLC' chat / plc-guardian-open-items.md section 2. %MW1 meaning unknown, not protected yet.
